SEQ-07A Monomial lattice with a strict decoder. SEQ-07B separately Registered shift class decoder and new control data. The results of the first approach are preserved without substitution.

Teams from the root of the project, PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Integrity first, if you have the team results omitting the computational stages, adding only JOURNAL.jsonl, It's removed from the integrity manifesto Do not delete: a new experiment should have its own folder.

  • PROTOCOL.md, MANIFEST.json: source and frozen code.
  • translation/PROTOCOL.md, translation/MANIFEST.json: a new decoder, Cause and independent control examples.
  • solver.pycubic conditions, modular linearization, LLL and a strict decoder.
  • translation_decoder.pyVerification of the relative chain, exact intervals general shift and conditional projection of the key No71.
  • inputs/, results/, lattices/: 78 Original packages and compressed certificates.
  • translation/inputs/, translation/results/, translation/lattices/: 36 The control truth is stored separately from the solver's input.
  • translation/DIAGNOSTIC.jsonApplication of a new decoder to the old Control grids; not an independent confirmation sample.
  • audit.py, audit_packets/, AUDIT.json: Independent inspection without new LLL.
  • REAL.json, translation/REAL.json: Structural assessment and closed admission.
  • ENVIRONMENT.json: SHA256 1792 Local dependency files.
  • PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json: SHA256 and mtime 714 previous accepted files.
  • ARTIFACTS.json, ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json: Integrity and acceptance boundaries.

Python 3.11.9, existing python-flint 0.9.0; SymPy It's just for audit. The packets were not installed CPU-process GPU. Don't take it heuristic_no_candidate for proof of incompatibility; Do not accept a single class as proof of global uniqueness.
